# Chaotically Organized AI (COAI)

> Industrial-Strength Revenue Infrastructure for Bakersfield contractors. COAI installs a call-first website, instant missed-call response, Google Business Profile cleanup, and lead routing the client owns. Serving HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and other high-call service businesses in Bakersfield and Kern County, CA. Founder: Jason Robert Manuel.

## Offers
COAI sells three things and nothing else.

1. Job-Call Leak Scorecard — free for qualified owner-operators, otherwise $350 Structural Audit credited to the build. Delivered in 24–48 hours. A one-page scorecard with three observed leaks, the assumptions behind them, screenshots, and one recommended first control.
2. TradeCall Revenue Infrastructure Build — $1,997 flat ($997 to start, $1,000 at launch). Call-first website, one aligned business identity, Google Business Profile cleanup, missed-call text-back, lead pipeline and owner alert, ownership handoff, launch QA, and a 30-day baseline scorecard. Bilingual EN/ES add-on +$400. Standard turnaround 2–3 weeks from signed scope.
3. Revenue Continuity — $197/month, cancel anytime. Routing, form, and SMS test log; response-time report; uncontacted-lead review; monthly scorecard; minor site and profile corrections; one improvement priority per month.

## Not Included
Ad spend, custom integrations, ongoing content beyond scope, carrier/SMS/AI usage fees, hosting, advanced CRM migration, and 24-hour human dispatch are not included in the build price.

## Recurring Third-Party Costs
These are paid by the client directly to the vendor, never to COAI.
- Hosting: $20–30/month (Vercel, in the client's own account)
- Phone/SMS: $15–50/month per number (Twilio, in the client's own account)

## Ownership
The client controls the domain registrar, hosting account, source code repository, analytics, Search Console, Google Business Profile, and all lead data. COAI deploys into the client's accounts, documents the setup, and hands over admin access. There is no platform lock-in and no monthly platform fee to COAI.

## Stack
Next.js with TypeScript, deployed on Vercel. Full source access and written handoff documentation.

## Service Area
Bakersfield, Delano, Shafter, Kern County, California.
